title: THE NORTHGATE MATCH
content: Students gather along the edge of the playing field for a friendly match. The teams are mixed by whoever arrived, the rules are agreed on the spot, and the best moment is a pass that nobody expected. Afterwards, both sides head toward the dining hall together.
